children: Dhanuka Agritech Ltd, an agri input company, has announced the rollout of ‘Polin’, a fungicide developed through its strategic technical collaboration with Japan’s Nippon Soda Co Ltd (NISSO) to protect crops against leaf and neck blast disease of rice.

A media statement said the formulation features dual translaminar and systemic mobility, penetrating crop tissue to protect unsprayed leaf areas and newly emerging plant growth. Applied at a calibrated dose of 100 ml per acre in 200 liters of water, Polin provides long lasting residual control when applied at first sign of infection during critical crop growth stages. By extending the protection window, the solution reduces overall spray frequency, directly lowering labour and chemical expenses for rice growers, it said.

Polin has been launched across different parts of Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh, where Dhanuka has also initiated awareness drives among paddy farmers to promote effective management of leaf and neck blast disease.

Quoting Rahul Dhanuka, Managing Director of Dhanuka Agritech Ltd, the statement said: “With Polin we are delivering patented Japanese chemistry with a completely new mode of action for control of rice blast. It gives farmers deeper and more durable protection from blast to healthy grains, cutting out repetitive spray costs. We believe that when a farmer invests in crop health, the chemistry must deliver absolute certainty.”
The company would be launching more solutions to help farmers in the coming months, Dhanuka added.

title: Dhanuka Agritech launches ‘Polin’ fungicide for paddy crop
